This file documents the configurations resource at the shell, one section per command. Every command is a subcommand of =configurations=, and every section exports its own script into =projects/ores.shell/scripts/library/=. Loading a script runs that one command, so a failure names the command it came from.

:ID: 8138C5F7-56FB-5F62-98EF-9BE6AB144090

** =set=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: 3D3C467D-8BEA-5759-8F3E-A054D8DBA3C8

Writes a row. The change states no precondition, so it replaces whatever row the key already addresses. The change carries a reason and a commentary, which the server records on it so the row's history says why it moved.
